responsibility: Contains unit tests and lightweight MIR/coverage graph test scaffolding for the coverage instrumentation module, validating coverage block construction, loop detection, and counter assignment behavior.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is specific to the coverage instrumentation module, building mock MIR to validate coverage-block formation, loop detection, and counter placement. In contrast, `dataflow/framework/tests.rs` tests the generic dataflow engine's cursor semantics.
